name: CSN 319 一套液压系统失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 319, you are parking at gate 51, you have received information C, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, ask for ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 319，停在 51 号登机口，已收到通播 C，从武汉飞往广州，请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN 319, gate 51, information C, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN 319，51 号登机口，通播 C，请求 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, when airborne, contact 119.7, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，起始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离地后联系 119.7，应答机 2515。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initially climb to 1200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, when airborne, contact 119.7, squawk 2515, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，起始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离地后联系 119.7，应答机 2515，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, due to military activity, expect 1 hour delay, you are number 5 for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，因军事活动，预计延误 1 小时，你是第 5 架离场。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 319, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 319，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, after Boeing 737 behind is clear, push back onto taxiway Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，后方 Boeing 737 避让后，推出至滑行道 Z4，正对 213 号登机口，机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: After B737 behind is clear, push back onto taxiway Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 后方 B737 避让后，推出至滑行道 Z4，正对 213 号登机口，机头朝东，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，跑道 36R 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of Runway 36R, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，跑道 36R 外等待，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready for takeoff, contact Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，准备好起飞，联系塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 319, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 319，跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, behind Boeing 737 on final, line up Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，在五边 Boeing 737 后，进入跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Behind B737 on final, line up Runway 36R, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在五边 B737 后，进入跑道 36R，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are passing 900 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你正通过 900 米，联系武汉离场。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, climb to 3900 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，爬升至 3900 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3900 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 3900 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, stop climbing due to converging traffic, level off at 2700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，因汇聚冲突飞机，停止爬升，在 2700 米改平。
cards.referenceText: Stop climb, level off at 2700 meters, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 停止爬升，在 2700 米改平，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, continue climb to 4500 meters.
B: During climb, you found 1 of your hydraulic systems has failed, make an Urgency call and tell ATC this situation and ask to level off at 3900 meters and then return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，你发现 1 套液压系统失效，发布紧急情况呼叫，告知 ATC 该情况，并请求在 3900 米改平后返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, CSN 319, 1 of our hydraulic systems has failed, request level off at 3900 meters and return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉离场，CSN 319，我们 1 套液压系统失效，请求在 3900 米改平并返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 319, roger PAN, maintain 3900 meters, turn left, direct to LKO, LKO-02 arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 319，收到 PAN，保持 3900 米，左转，直飞 LKO，LKO-02 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 3900 meters, turn left, direct to LKO, LKO-02 arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 3900 米，左转，直飞 LKO，LKO-02 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN 319。

cards.audioText: B: A thunderstorm was detected near LKO, report it to Wuhan Approach and ask to deviate 20 miles to the left.
cards.audioTextZh: B：LKO 附近探测到雷暴，向武汉进近报告并请求向左偏置 20 海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 319, there is a thunderstorm near LKO, request offset 20 miles to the left.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 319，LKO 附近有雷暴，请求向左偏置 20 海里。
